items.description: Surge-damaged home electronics (speaker system and TV set), 2 pcs
items.rationale: Covered under 2.3.3/4.2.4 as appliances damaged by lightning overvoltage, capped at the EUR 5,000 appliance sub-limit. No surge protector was in place per the loss notification, so indemnity is halved: assumed standard-grade TV plus speaker system of about EUR 2,800 (7.1.9) x 0.5 = about EUR 1,400.

items.description: Diagnostic surge-failure report and technician call-out, 3 pcs
items.rationale: A diagnostic report and wiring safety check are not repair costs (1.3, 7.1.8(e), 5.1 exhaustive list). The bundled call-out follows the line's predominant non-indemnifiable purpose under 7.1.10, so likely t = 0; if paid, a modest attendance charge of about EUR 180 is assumed.
